tasks.title: Freeze the first model/data workload
tasks.acceptance: Record lawful model/data sources, tokenizer, prompt/output distributions, quality target, latency requirements and evaluation split.

tasks.title: Audit backends and measurement support
tasks.acceptance: Review exact versions/licenses/security, local hardware availability, energy measurement and approved resource limits.

tasks.title: Build the experiment skeleton
tasks.acceptance: CLI schema distinguishes simulated/measured runs, rejects missing quality metadata and runs a synthetic trace parser without model downloads.

tasks.title: Integrate one inference backend
tasks.acceptance: Record complete request/token accounting, warmup/startup and latency distributions on a pinned local workload.

tasks.title: Implement a tiny training baseline
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce held-out loss and total work across declared seeds; record optimizer, data order and memory.

tasks.title: Calibrate analytical cost models
tasks.acceptance: Fit only on calibration runs and report prediction error on held-out workloads; label simulated outputs.

tasks.title: Compare batching and cache policies
tasks.acceptance: Use identical arrival traces and model outputs/quality constraints; include dropped, timed-out and failed requests.

tasks.title: Compare packing or checkpointing in training
tasks.acceptance: Compare time-to-quality and memory with equivalent data exposure; include all overhead and failed runs.

tasks.title: Publish the baseline Pareto report
tasks.acceptance: Regenerate quality, latency, memory and cost tradeoffs from raw traces with uncertainty and no universal speedup claim.

tasks.title: Test evaluator and workload immutability
tasks.acceptance: Reject changed tokenizers, truncated outputs, missing requests and altered quality thresholds.

tasks.title: Measure variance and tail behavior
tasks.acceptance: Randomize run order, repeat baseline/candidate pairs and report confidence intervals and p95/p99 behavior.

tasks.title: Confirm on untouched workloads
tasks.acceptance: Separate search from confirmation prompts/data and document hardware/thermal controls.

tasks.title: Evaluate quantization and speculative decoding
tasks.acceptance: Test quality loss and output equivalence where claimed; compare equal workloads and end-to-end overhead.

tasks.title: Evaluate precision, optimizer and kernel choices
tasks.acceptance: Use numerical/gradient checks and quality targets; reject unstable or silently lower-precision comparisons.

tasks.title: Model distributed training and serving
tasks.acceptance: Account for communication, stragglers and memory; hardware results require approved real runs distinct from simulation.

tasks.title: Build profiler-grounded hypotheses
tasks.acceptance: Tie each proposal to a measured bottleneck and a falsifiable performance/quality expectation.

tasks.title: Compare search with fixed baselines
tasks.acceptance: Use equal experiment/compute budgets and protected quality tests; keep negative results.

tasks.title: Confirm and package robust recipes
tasks.acceptance: A fresh run reproduces selected gains with the exact hardware/workload scope and failure conditions.

tasks.title: Build the efficiency comparison view
tasks.acceptance: Expose simulated/measured labels, quality gates, full costs and invalid results with accessible tables.

tasks.title: Add resource-limited workers
tasks.acceptance: Enforce process, storage and time quotas; stop runaway jobs and reconcile interrupted experiment costs.

tasks.title: Export reproducible recipe bundles
tasks.acceptance: Bundle lawful configurations and traces; another machine can inspect without credentials and reproduce supported tests.

tasks.title: Replicate on a second device or backend
tasks.acceptance: Report which recipes transfer; keep per-hardware outcomes separate rather than averaging away regressions.

tasks.title: Audit measurement and researcher workflow
tasks.acceptance: An independent reviewer checks quality parity, accounting and fresh reproduction of a claimed improvement.

tasks.title: Prepare the research preview
tasks.acceptance: Ship a bounded benchmark suite and supported recipes with maintainer approval; no unsupported best-in-class claims.
